summary: All six "X likely" diagnoses (insect bites, scabies, PPE, eczema, urticaria, drug rash) are encoded as probable rules with valid SNOMED concepts and the right and/or structure. The most consequential misses are the two diagnostic statements in the treatment text: "likely impetigo" with yellow crusts and "exclude asthma" with recurrent cough or wheeze. The PPE concept assumes HIV, the insect-bite rule is non-specific, and the discriminators "itchy at night" and "wheals disappear within 24 h" are lost. The red box is only a cross-reference to page 82, so it correctly has no priority rule.
